coaching.my-instructions:
CRITICAL SKILL: decompose-before-acting

Before starting this multi-step task:
1. DECOMPOSE — List all steps needed before writing any code
2. SEQUENCE — Order steps so each builds on verified success of the previous
3. CHECKPOINT — After each step, verify it worked before proceeding

When hitting an unexpected error:
1. STOP — Do not immediately retry
2. DIAGNOSE — What went wrong and why?
3. REPLAN — Choose a different approach if needed

ESPECIALLY: After fixing a bug, run the FULL test suite, not just the failing test. Check that your fix didn't break anything else.
